overview:
**Fire danger is High today in the Montrose (High Elevation) area, driven by dry, receptive fuels (ERC 88%, BI 86%) even with light winds.**
- Danger climbs to Very High by Wednesday (Aug 26) and holds there through Saturday as ERC/BI push toward the mid-90s and fuels keep drying.
- Winds stay light (7–14 mph, ENE/NE) but afternoon humidity crashes into the teens by Friday, sharpening afternoon burn risk.
- No Red Flag Warning is posted, and 0 of 7 local watchout thresholds are currently met.
- Unincorporated Gunnison County has been under Stage 2 fire restrictions since August 15, while GMUG National Forest lands moved from Stage 2 to Stage 1
